lines: It melts away as if sinking
On a night when only our sky expands
It was just “good‑bye”
That one word made everything clear
The sky dimming and your silhouette
Overlapped beyond the fence
Since the day we first met
You stole every piece of my heart
You wear a fragile, fleeting air
Your eyes were lonely
Always ticking, tick‑tack
In a world that rings, over and over
To harsh words and noisy voices that touch
Even if tears threaten to fall
We can find ordinary joy together
To you who cannot smile amid noisy days
I’ll imagine the brightest tomorrow I can
Before we fall into the endless night
Grab my hand, look
Even the days I locked away to forget
Will melt in the warmth I hold you with
It’s not scary, until the sun finally rises
Let’s stay together
Only you can see
I hate how you stare at something
Like you’re dazzled, like you’re falling in love
I hate that face
I want to believe, yet I can’t
No matter what, surely
There will be many more from now on
Each time you’ll get angry and cry
Still, someday, surely, we’ll surely
Understand each other, I believe
I’m tired of saying I hate it
You swat away my desperate hand
I’m tired of saying I hate it
The truth is, I want to say it too
Ah, hear the tick‑tack again
In a world that rings, over and over
Every word I prepared for you falls short
“I want to end this,” they say
When I was lured into saying it
You smiled for the first time
You’d stopped smiling amid noisy days
You look beautiful in my eyes
Even the tears that fell in the endless night
Melt into your smile
You gently guide the me who wept in unchanging days toward the end
Take my hand that never lets go
It melts away as if sinking
The clinging mist clears
To the days I locked away to forget
I take the hand you reached out
A cool wind swims across the sky, now rushing through
Don’t let go of our linked hands
We dash into the night together
